## Classes

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ScramBuffer`](/scripting/common/ScramBuffer) | Key-value data that scripts send in script packets. |
| [`ScramLogger`](/scripting/common/ScramLogger) | Script logger, available to every script as the global `console`, like in JavaScript. |
| [`ScriptBox`](/scripting/common/ScriptBox) | Detached axis-aligned bounding box in blocks. |
| [`ScriptFactory`](/scripting/common/ScriptFactory) | Creates script values, available as the global `scram`: vectors, texts, item stacks, NBT, forms and transforms, script UIs, textures, camera shakes and packet handlers. |
| [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) | Styled chat text: color, formatting, hover text and click actions. |
| [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | Three-dimensional vector: a position, rotation, direction or size, from `scram.vector(x, y, z)` or returned by the API. |
